# Perl version test vectors, measured against perl:5.40-slim.
#
# Every row was produced by real perl, not by hand: version->parse($s) and <=> inside
# perl:5.40-slim. The identical table drives grype's Go comparator, so the two implementations
# agree pair for pair. Do not edit, reorder, or drop entries here without making the same change
# on the Go side, or the two silently diverge.
#
# The numify and is_alpha columns are recorded for completeness only. Perl_vcmp reads neither, so
# ordering does not depend on them (1.23_01 > 1.23 because its digits fold into the numeric groups,
# not because of any pre-release rule).

# parse edges, lax mode
''          -> FAIL (version required)
'abc'       -> FAIL (non-numeric data)
'v'         -> FAIL (dotted-decimal versions require at least three parts)
'1..2'      -> FAIL (fractional part required)
'1_2'       -> FAIL (alpha without decimal)
'1.2.3.4.5' -> v1.2.3.4.5
'0'         -> v0.0.0
'v0'        -> v0.0.0
'.5'        -> v0.500.0
'1.'        -> v1.0.0
